questions.q: Which is the decision version of the travelling salesman problem?
options: What is the minimum cost tour?
Is there a tour of total cost at most K?

questions.q: A binary file is 20 bytes long. After f = open('d.bin','rb') and f.read(8), what does f.tell() return?
questions.exp: Reading 8 bytes advances the file pointer to offset 8.

questions.q:

questions.q:
Match the Pandas DataFrame feature with its purpose:
(i) df.head()  (ii) df.shape  (iii) df.describe()  (iv) df.drop('x', axis=1)

questions.exp: head shows the first 5 rows, shape is (rows, columns), describe gives statistics, drop removes a column.

questions.exp: The carry ripples through all 16 stages: 16 × 10 ns = 160 ns.

options: Will not modify the data members of the object

questions.q: VoLTE stands for:

questions.q: A schedule is recoverable if
options: a transaction that reads data written by another transaction commits only after that other transaction commits
every transaction commits immediately after it starts
no two transactions access the same item

questions.q: In an RFID system, the device that sends radio signals to power a passive tag and reads its ID is the:
questions.exp: A passive tag has no battery; the reader energises it and reads the stored ID.

questions.exp: SHA-256 gives a 256-bit digest, used in Bitcoin.

questions.q: A program flow graph drawn as a planar graph has 6 regions (including the outer region). Its cyclomatic complexity is
questions.exp: V(G) equals the number of regions of the planar flow graph, so V(G) = 6.

questions.q: When a parent process terminates before its child, the child process is adopted by:
options: the shell that started the parent
questions.exp: Orphaned children are re-parented to init/systemd (PID 1), which reaps them on exit.

questions.q: The cost of fixing a defect is generally lowest when the defect is detected during:
questions.exp: The relative cost of correcting an error rises steeply with each later phase, so early reviews and inspections are the most economical.

questions.q: In panic-mode error recovery, the parser
options: discards input symbols until it finds a synchronizing token
replaces the erroneous symbol by a default value
questions.exp: Panic mode skips input until a delimiter such as a semicolon allows parsing to resume.

questions.q: Copying the magnetic-stripe data of a debit card with a small device fitted on an ATM slot is called
questions.exp: Skimmers read card data (often with a hidden camera for the PIN) to clone cards.

questions.q: How many different topological orderings does the DAG with edges A->B, A->C, B->D and C->D have?

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a method of recovering from deadlock?
options: Aborting processes one at a time until the cycle is broken
Increasing the time quantum of the CPU scheduler
questions.exp: Recovery uses process termination or resource preemption; changing the quantum has no effect on the deadlock.

questions.q: Why is a three-tier architecture considered more secure than a two-tier one?
options: all data is stored on the client machine
it uses HTTP instead of TCP
the database can be reached only through the application server, not directly from clients
questions.exp: In 3-tier, clients never connect to the DBMS directly, so access control and validation sit in the middle tier.

questions.q: To transfer a 16-bit word starting at an even address, the 8086 makes BHE and A0 respectively
questions.exp: BHE = 0 enables the upper half of the data bus and A0 = 0 enables the lower half, so both bytes transfer in one cycle.

questions.q: Which statement about HashMap in Java is correct?
options: It does not allow null values
It maintains elements in sorted order
questions.exp: HashMap permits one null key and many null values; it is unsynchronised and unordered.

questions.q: Which IEEE standard describes Bluetooth-type wireless personal area networking?
questions.exp: 802.15.1 was the basis of Bluetooth, while 802.15.4 is used by ZigBee.

questions.q: Two interfaces in Java declare the same default method and a class implements both. The code compiles only if:
options: The compiler is left to choose the first interface
One of the interfaces is declared final
questions.exp: The conflict must be resolved by overriding the method in the implementing class.

questions.q: According to Thomas' write rule in timestamp ordering, if TS(T) < W-TS(X) and T attempts to write X, the system
options: ignores the obsolete write and lets T continue
questions.exp: Thomas' write rule skips outdated writes instead of aborting the transaction, increasing concurrency.

questions.exp: J = D, K = D' gives Q+ = DQ' + DQ = D.

questions.q: Which of the following functions is tail recursive?
options: int f(int n){ if(n==0) return 1; return n*f(n-1); }
int f(int n){ if(n<2) return n; return f(n-1)+f(n-2); }
int f(int n,int acc){ if(n==0) return acc; return f(n-1, acc*n); }
int f(int n){ if(n==0) return 0; return 1+f(n-1); }
questions.exp: Only the first has the recursive call as its very last action with nothing left to do afterwards.

questions.q:

a process spends executing on the CPU
from submission of a request until the first response is produced
questions.exp: Response time measures how soon the first output is produced, important for interactive systems.

questions.q: Macromedia/Adobe Authorware, an authoring tool, is based on which authoring metaphor?
questions.exp: Authorware builds a product by placing icons on a flowline; Flash and Director are timeline based, ToolBook is page based.

questions.q: Which construct is discouraged in structured programming because it makes control flow hard to follow?
questions.exp: Structured programming relies on sequence, selection and iteration and avoids unrestricted jumps such as goto.

questions.q: The principle of least privilege states that

questions.exp: Limiting rights reduces damage from errors or compromise.

questions.q: Which of the following is a vector graphics file format?

questions.q: A small, subject-specific subset of a data warehouse built for one department (for example marketing) is called a:

questions.q:

options: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.exp: x = 5 evaluates to 5, any non-zero value counts as true in C, so the condition is always true.

questions.q: What is the time complexity of deleting the minimum element from a binary min-heap with n elements?
questions.exp: The last element replaces the root and sifts down along one root-to-leaf path of height log n.

questions.q: Which of the following problems is decidable for context-free grammars?
options: whether two grammars G1 and G2 generate the same language

questions.q: Silly window syndrome is a problem related to:

kernel-level software that lets the OS communicate with a hardware device controller
a hardware component inside the disk
a type of CPU scheduling policy

A class should have a single responsibility
Clients should not depend on interfaces they do not use
questions.exp: LSP requires subtypes to be substitutable for their base types.

questions.exp: The loaded data is available only after MEM, so even with forwarding one bubble is needed (load-use hazard).

questions.q: The principle of least privilege states that:
options: all users should have administrator rights
a user or program should be given only the access rights needed to do its task
access rights should never be revoked
only the kernel may run programs
questions.exp: Least privilege limits damage from errors or attacks by restricting each domain to the minimum rights necessary.

questions.q: In a canonical (minimal) cover of a set of functional dependencies, every dependency has

only prime attributes on its left side
a single attribute on its right-hand side, with no extraneous attribute and no redundant dependency
a candidate key on its left side

questions.q: Which statement about constructors in a Java abstract class is correct?
options: Constructors are not allowed because the class cannot be instantiated
A constructor is allowed and runs, through super(), when a subclass object is created
A constructor is allowed but can never be executed
Only a static constructor is allowed

questions.exp: PAL: programmable AND, fixed OR. PLA: both programmable. PROM/ROM: fixed AND (decoder), programmable OR.

questions.q: Creative Commons licences are used to
options: Let creators grant specified permissions for others to share and reuse their work
questions.exp: CC licences are standard copyright licences that state what reuse is permitted.

questions.q: A zero-day attack is one that
options: Occurs on the day a computer is bought
Exploits a vulnerability unknown to the vendor for which no patch yet exists
Deletes all data in zero days
questions.exp: Defenders have had 'zero days' to prepare a fix.

questions.q: Which of the following is an individual aim of education?

questions.q: Why is sex education considered important in schools?
options: It gives correct scientific knowledge and removes myths and misconceptions
It is useful only for adults
questions.exp: Accurate information helps adolescents develop healthy attitudes.

questions.q:

Reason (R): Evaluation tells whether the objectives were achieved.

options: Both A and R are true but R does not explain A
A is true and R is false

A is false and R is true

questions.q:

Both Statements I and II are false

questions.exp: National Youth Day is observed on 12 January, Swami Vivekananda's birthday.

questions.q: The national song of India, 'Vande Mataram', was composed by
questions.exp: Vande Mataram appeared in Bankim Chandra's novel Anandamath (1882); Tagore wrote the national anthem.

questions.q: The Earth Summit held at Rio de Janeiro in 1992 resulted in which of the following?
options: Convention on Biological Diversity and Agenda 21
questions.exp: The 1992 UN Conference on Environment and Development opened CBD and UNFCCC for signature and adopted Agenda 21.

questions.q: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) was set up by
questions.exp: IPCC was established in 1988 by the United Nations Environment Programme and World Meteorological Organization.

questions.q: Landslides in hilly areas are mainly aggravated by
questions.exp: Removal of vegetation loosens soil, which slides down during heavy rain.

questions.q: Which of the following is the first step in the disaster management cycle aimed at reducing the impact of a future disaster?
questions.exp: Mitigation and preparedness precede response and recovery measures.

questions.q: Which of the following is a renewable resource?
questions.exp: Forests regenerate if managed sustainably, unlike fossil fuels.

questions.q: If the side of a square is increased by 10%, by what percent does its area increase?
questions.exp: New area = (1.1)² = 1.21 of the old area, an increase of 21%.

questions.q: What is the amount on Rs 10000 at 20% per annum for 1 year, compounded half-yearly?
questions.exp: Rate per half-year = 10% for 2 periods: 10000 x 1.1 x 1.1 = 12100.

questions.q: Simplify (x² - 9)/(x - 3) for x ≠ 3.
questions.exp: x² - 9 = (x - 3)(x + 3), so the quotient is x + 3.

questions.q: What is the smallest 4-digit number divisible by 12?
A rectangular tank is 5 m long, 4 m wide and 3 m deep. What is its capacity in litres?
questions.exp: Volume = 5 x 4 x 3 = 60 m³ = 60 x 1000 = 60,000 litres.

questions.q: In a certain code, CAT is written as 3120 and DOG as 4157. How is COT written in that code?
questions.exp: Each letter is replaced by its alphabet position and joined: C=3, O=15, T=20, giving 31520.

questions.q: Find the next number: 4, 7, 11, 18, 29, ?
questions.exp: Each term is the sum of the previous two: 18 + 29 = 47.
27 = 3³, so the same relation gives 4³ = 64.

questions.q: Which of the following letter pairs is the odd one out?
questions.exp: In EG, IK and QS the second letter is two places after the first; in MN it is one place after.

questions.q: How many days are there from 15 January to 10 March of a non-leap year, excluding both the dates?
questions.exp: Remaining days of January (16 to 31) = 16; February = 28; March 1 to 9 = 9. Total = 16 + 28 + 9 = 53.
